nodes.summary: Not every finite group $G$ with $|\mathrm{Aut}(G)| = \varphi(|G|)$ is cyclic: there is a non-cyclic finite group $G$ with $|\mathrm{Aut}(G)| = \varphi(|G|)$, where $\varphi$ is Euler's totient function and $\mathrm{Aut}(G)$ is the group of automorphisms of $G$.
nodes.title: Deaconescu's cyclicity conjecture fails (Kourovka 15.43(b))

nodes.summary: The statement that every finite group $G$ with $|\mathrm{Aut}(G)| = \varphi(|G|)$ is cyclic, where $\varphi$ is Euler's totient function and $\mathrm{Aut}(G)$ is the group of automorphisms of $G$.
nodes.title: Deaconescu's cyclicity conjecture (Kourovka 15.43(b))

nodes.summary: There is a function $f : \mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{N}$, the same for all primes, such that for every $n \in \mathbb{N}$, every prime $p$ and every finite group $G$, if $p^{f(n)}$ divides $|G|$ then $p^n$ divides $|\mathrm{Aut}(G)|$, where $\mathrm{Aut}(G)$ is the group of automorphisms of $G$.
nodes.title: Green's theorem on prime powers dividing the order of the automorphism group (Kourovka 18.82)

nodes.summary: The statement that there is a function $f : \mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{N}$ such that for every $n \in \mathbb{N}$, every prime $p$ and every finite group $G$, if $p^{f(n)}$ divides $|G|$ then $p^n$ divides $|\mathrm{Aut}(G)|$, where $\mathrm{Aut}(G)$ is the group of automorphisms of $G$.
nodes.title: Patne's prime-power divisibility problem (Kourovka 18.82)

nodes.summary: For every prime $p$ there is a finite non-cyclic $p$-group $P$ of order greater than $p^2$ whose order does not divide the order of its automorphism group $\mathrm{Aut}(P)$.
nodes.title: Orders of $p$-groups need not divide orders of their automorphism groups

nodes.summary: The statement that there is a prime $p$ such that for every finite non-cyclic $p$-group $P$ of order greater than $p^2$, the order of $P$ divides the order of its automorphism group $\mathrm{Aut}(P)$.
nodes.title: Divisibility conjecture for orders of automorphism groups of $p$-groups (Kourovka 12.77)

nodes.summary: Not every finite group $G$ satisfies $\varphi(|G|) \le |\mathrm{Aut}(G)|$: there is a finite group $G$ with $|\mathrm{Aut}(G)| < \varphi(|G|)$, where $\varphi$ is Euler's totient function and $\mathrm{Aut}(G)$ is the group of automorphisms of $G$.
nodes.title: Deaconescu's totient lower bound conjecture fails (Kourovka 15.43(a))

nodes.summary: The statement that every finite group $G$ satisfies $\varphi(|G|) \le |\mathrm{Aut}(G)|$, where $\varphi$ is Euler's totient function and $\mathrm{Aut}(G)$ is the group of automorphisms of $G$.
nodes.title: Deaconescu's totient lower bound conjecture (Kourovka 15.43(a))

can_prove.label: ready to prove

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
